title: Stellar Forge
description: A progression-based magic mod that introduces powerful spells, ancient artifacts, and new crafting systems
body:
CoolMod is an ambitious project currently in active development. Right now, it introduces the foundation of powerful new resources, ores, and crafting mechanics — but this is only the beginning. The goal of CoolMod is to grow into one of the most powerful and game-changing mods available for Minecraft.

Future updates will expand the mod with:

Unique ores and rare materials hidden deep within dangerous biomes.

Advanced crafting recipes and progression systems.

Custom weapons, tools, and armor designed to surpass vanilla gear.

Powerful mechanics that push the boundaries of survival, exploration, and combat.

Although it’s still early in development, CoolMod is built with big plans for the future. Expect it to evolve into a mod where players can harness immense strength, discover mysterious resources, and eventually wield some of the strongest gear in the Minecraft modding universe.

Stay tuned — this is just the start of something legendary.
